messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-46233 fired — SEV:P1 — Elevated 502/524 errors from edge -> inference-prod (us-west-2) for route /v1/chat. See runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/network-alb-dns

pagerduty: Trigger: upstream 502 ratio > 7% over 3m. Escalation policy: net->infra->oncall.

rachel (oncall-net): ack — taking lead. Noticed spike at 11:04UTC. First checks: ALB target health and TLS errors.

ben (oncall-app): app noticing `TLS record overflow` and `handshake failure` in pod logs around same time. Multiple backends failing fast.

rachel (oncall-net): ALB target health check output (sample):
```
Target i-0f1a2b3c: unhealthy — Reason="SSL handshake failure"
Target i-0d2e3f4a: unhealthy — Reason="Connection reset by peer"
```

rachel (oncall-net): running `openssl s_client -connect old-alb.prod.redwood.ai:443 -servername inference.prod` shows cert served has no intermediate chain and client rejects.

tess (sre): any recent automated cert rotates? I saw a cert-maint pipeline job that updated ACM certs last night for new-alb but there was an error on old-alb import.

omar (infra-lead): we ran a phased cert rollout. Looks like arn:aws:acm:...:cert/old was replaced on new ALB but old ALB import failed to include the full chain. Also noticed health check config drift — old-target-group had plaintext health check port 8080 while new has 8443. That mismatch could exacerbate perception of unhealthy.

ana (cs): multiple customers reporting 502s. I have calls queued. Need ETA for fix.

rachel (oncall-net): mitigation options: 1) re-import full cert chain to old ALB (fast, fixes TLS), 2) force failover to new ALB by changing Route53 weighted record to 100% new, 3) update ALB listener to present correct cert ARN immediately if ACM has it.

ben (oncall-app): app prefers option 3 if possible — swap listener cert on old ALB to the working ARN (if present) so we don't depend on DNS. Does ACM show the new full-chain cert in region?

rachel (oncall-net): checking ACM: `aws acm list-certificates --region us-west-2` shows cert/new-alb-arn present and in ISSUED state. Old-alb import was marked INCOMPLETE.

rachel (oncall-net): executing quick listener update to point old ALB to new cert ARN (rolling back bad import):
```
aws elbv2 describe-listeners --load-balancer-arn arn:aws:.../old-alb
aws elbv2 modify-listener --listener-arn arn:aws:.../listener-1 --certificates CertificateArn=arn:aws:acm:...:cert/new-alb-arn
```

rachel (oncall-net): update applied. Re-checking handshake: `openssl s_client -connect old-alb.prod.redwood.ai:443 -servername inference.prod` now shows full chain and verify OK.

tess (sre): monitoring metrics: 502 rate fell from 7.3% -> 0.9% in last 2 minutes. Latency stable. Nice.

omar (infra-lead): follow-up: we need to fix the import pipeline to always upload chain bundle (cert + intermediates) and add a post-import verification step. I'll file a ticket.

ana (cs): notifying customers: update sent — we expect full recovery; will follow up with root cause and timeline for credits if SLA impacted.

rachel (oncall-net): small gotcha: Route53 weighted record still 30/70 old->new due to leftover weight. I'll set weight to 0 for old to speed convergence, TTL is 60s.

rachel (oncall-net): Route53 change submitted (change id: C0ABCDEF). Setting old weight=0.

ben (oncall-app): app logs show no new TLS errors. Health checks to target groups returning healthy across both ALBs.

omar (infra-lead): action items (assigned):
- infra: add cert bundle verification in import job (omar)
- net: audit weighted DNS records for prod services, standardize weights/TTL during cutovers (rachel)
- release: add canary verification that both ALBs serve correct certs after rollout (ben)
- cs: prepare customer follow-ups and SLA review (ana)

tess (sre): marking incident mitigated -> monitoring. We'll keep alerts at lower thresholds for next 2 hours. If 502s exceed 1% reopen.

rachel (oncall-net): handing off monitoring to ben in 20m. I'll be reachable if it spikes.

ana (cs): all affected customers notified. Case refs: CS-99210, CS-99211.

ben (oncall-app): will close thread in 30m if stable. Good work team :thumbsup:

# Thread status: mitigated (listener cert swap + DNS weight update) -> monitoring
